description: Free. The weekly trading review for any perp trader's address, from public on-chain data: P&L and where it came from, fees, funding, wins and losses, hold times, open positions with and without a stop, and three fixes. Defaults to the last full week; week='current' covers this week so far. One review per address and week, shared by everyone who asks; share_url opens it on the web.

week.description: ISO week like 2026-W45, or 'current' for this week so far. Default: the last full week.
week.title: Week
